verdict.rationale: The Agent SDK is a thin wrapper that spawns the Claude CLI subprocess and calls Anthropic's hosted Claude models via API — there is no evidence of an open-source model or a way to run the 'core product' (the underlying agent/model) independently of Anthropic's cloud. Docs describe deploying the SDK's orchestration layer in Docker/Kubernetes (docs-11, docs-20), but this still depends entirely on Anthropic's hosted inference and subscription/API access, and community evidence shows Anthropic actively restricting how/where the SDK-driven agent can be used (comm-1, comm-4), the opposite of self-hosting the core product.
